column17: src/parser.c:424 `type->offset = offset;` writes a host-owned AstType node. The write IS the host-graph mutation, and the write target is reached by identity through the ClsField*. The only production call site (src/parser.c:718) passes CalcClassSize as a u32(*)(List *) callback, so the ABI would have to carry host graph identity.

No production call site exists for a size-only sub-slice. The offset write (src/parser.c:424) is interleaved with the size accumulation in the SAME loop, so a pure sub-slice would have to duplicate the alignment walk and would then have to be wired through a NEW callback contract in parseClassOrUnion. Not independently nominable.

The only production call site (src/parser.c:722) passes CalcUnionSize as a u32 (*computeSize)(List *) FUNCTION POINTER into parseClassOrUnion. Delegating it would require changing that callback contract in production source and materialising a bounded copied size sequence at every call. The state boundary is clean (R0=0) but the production seam is a callback contract, not an ordinary call site. NOT FEASIBLE under the ACT's successor scope.

The single production call site (src/parser.c:2193) passes an AoStr* whose length is unbounded at the ABI level. A bounded ABI would require a length-capped copy, which changes the semantics for large asm bodies.
